description: Native Instagram hashtag Explore — Reels-heavy top surface with real likes, views, captions, and paid flags. Flat 2 credits. Costs 2 credits. Empty results and failures are never charged. Pass cache=true for a free 24h cache hit (default always fresh).

cache.description: Set true to serve from the 24h response cache (0 credits on hit). Default false — always fetch fresh. Envelope includes cached + cachedAt on hits.

limit.description: Max items to return (default 20, max 200). Flat 2 credits per call.

mediaType.description: all (default) or reels — return only Reels/clips when set to reels.
